d: HardRPG: play RPG Maker XP, VX, VX Ace, 2000 and 2003 games on PS Vita.
ld: Copy your games to the Vita and play them from a game library with covers. XP, VX and VX Ace games run natively on mkxp-z-vita, this repository's Vita port of mkxp-z. RPG Maker 2000 and 2003 games run on the EasyRPG Player that comes built in. RPG Maker Dante 98 and Dante 98 II games (the PC-98 RPG Makers) run natively on a built-in port of OpenDT. It is free, open source homebrew for any Vita with HENkaku or Ensō.
req:
- Copy each game's folder into ux0:/data/hardrpg/games/.
- Copy everything inside app/ to ux0:/data/hardrpg/rtp/Standard/.
- Copy everything inside app/ to ux0:/data/hardrpg/rtp/RPGVX/.
- Copy everything inside app/ to ux0:/data/hardrpg/rtp/RPGVXAce/.
- Copy everything inside RTP2000/ to ux0:/data/hardrpg/rtp/2000/.
- Copy everything inside RTP2003/ to ux0:/data/hardrpg/rtp/2003/.
- start. The copy is kept in ux0:/data/hardrpg/rescue/ and never replaces your
- [Original game fonts](#original-game-fonts) to use your own copy.
